name: Alfa Ica (India) Limited
about: Alfa Ica (India) Limited manufactures and sells high pressure laminated sheets and compacts in India and internationally. The company offers compact grade, cubicle compact, post formable, anti-bacterial, interior and exterior grade, flooring grade, tough gloss, laboratory grade, fire retardant, uni-core, and color compact laminates. It also provides real metal foils, dry wipe boards, tile panels, and anti-fingerprint products. Its products have applications in furniture covering, wall paneling, partitions, door covering, shower panels, interior wall paneling, exterior wall cladding, green chalk board, white marker board, dry wipe boards, kitchen top and backsplash, cubicle partition panel, green chalk board/white market, anti-fingerprint laminate, tabletop, fire retardant, and other areas. The company also exports its products. Alfa Ica (India) Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
